entries.reason: Existing Phase-1/2 replay contract remains supported and unchanged.
Additive canonical successor boundary for future harness integration; no ranking effect.
The canonical client request remains the source of explicit inputs; Phase 3A adds typed dimension and constraint declarations without copying it.
Future phase may bind the Phase-3A snapshot; Phase 3A does not rewrite the validated Phase-2 envelope.
Current client inputs are legacy transport evidence; no Phase-3A wiring.
Current web payload remains a legacy consumer contract; no Phase-3A wiring.
City plus two mood strings cannot represent authority, privacy, constraints, provenance, or registry identity. Production remains unchanged.
Presentation-oriented mode/title/time-bucket result is not a vNext Context authority. No deprecation action in this slice.
Retrieval, intent interpretation, context and score behavior are coupled. It remains frozen Production behavior.
Useful legacy input evidence, not a canonical vNext contract.
Legacy context-key lookup is coupled to retrieval and scoring and cannot establish per-dimension vNext provenance. Production remains unchanged.
Current request facts and conservative budget behavior are audit evidence, not a canonical vNext Context contract or policy.
Historical deterministic evaluation evidence stays intact and is not imported as the vNext Context domain model.
The v13 operational radius cannot choose Phase-3A Context authority or policy.
Persisted query, mood, audience and context-key records are not Context authority and are not consumed by the kernel.
Device coordinates require server authorization and minimization before entering vNext Context.
Review submission context must not become an implicit User Intelligence writeback.
Only a port exists; no provider, taxonomy, cost, or production authority is selected.
Fixture registry is explicitly non-canonical and product semantics remain not configured.
